verdict.rationale: Orrick offers digital self-service products (Tech Studio form generators, Orrick Labs legal tech, Orrick Connect client portals), so a published API spec is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows any public API, OpenAPI document or equivalent machine-readable spec. The llms.txt probe returning 404 is a separate capability and does not bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
